account: There seems to be a coordinated undertaking that has not been explained to me. The secretary reports that builder delivered twenty-four loaves to the great hall, that baker agreed to exchange wheat for builder's spare planks and lanterns, and that the materials changed hands. Freight and innkeeper are helping coordinate supplies. Earlier townsfolk reported seeing baker carrying bread at the inn, and I saw a lantern added in the hall area this morning. These suggest preparations for a gathering rather than ordinary individual purchases, though I have not verified their purpose. The innkeeper specifically requested a meeting with me tomorrow at 18:00 in the great hall, asked me not to arrive early, and gave no further explanation. Together these details make me suspect a surprise celebration or communal meal, possibly for me, but that remains a guess. My neighbour met innkeeper, builder, freight, baker, and secretary this morning and offered baking help, so may also know something; their account stressed neighbours helping one another and disclosed no concern. I have just asked the secretary what the loaves are for and who requested them, and am awaiting a reply. There is no evidence of wrongdoing: the treasury still held 128 emeralds when inspected, untouched, although the payment ledgers have not been located.
